STATUS: fail

SUMMARY: Tabs and Dialog held up under about 40 probes, including keyboard, focus, nesting and StrictMode cases. The Combobox fails two explicit acceptance criteria: Enter with empty text and no active option, and blur after clearing text, both call `onChange(null)` where C5 and C8 say nothing should change. The README (lines 138–144) documents this as intended, so the code and spec disagree on purpose.

FILES TOUCHED: none (scratch probes `tests/__probe_{combo,dialog,tabs,extra}.test.tsx` were created, run, and deleted; `git status` matches the starting state)

FINDINGS:
- [blocking] Combobox Enter with cleared text and no active option calls `onChange(null)` and closes. Violates C5 ("Enter with no active option does nothing"). Source: `Combobox.tsx` `else if (query === "") clear();`. Repro: `user.clear(input); user.keyboard("{Enter}")` → `expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` fails with "called 1 times".
- [blocking] Combobox blur after clearing text calls `onChange(null)` and wipes the selection instead of restoring the selected label. Violates C8. Source: `handleBlur` → `clear()`. Repro: `defaultValue="apple"`, `user.clear(input)`, `user.tab()` → onChange called once, expected 0.
- [minor] Clicking the Combobox input does not open the popup; only ArrowDown or typing does. The spec does not require click-to-open, so this is a usability note. Not reproduced as a spec failure.
- [minor] Dialog focus trap only engages when the keydown target is inside the dialog. A Tab from focus outside the dialog is not pulled back by the trap. I could not reproduce a real escape, because the portal sits at the end of body, so the next Tab lands inside the dialog anyway. Not reproduced.
- [minor] OPEN QUESTIONS below mentions FEATURE_FLOW.md, which does not exist in the repo.
- [minor] Tab's `id` and `role` props are silently overridden by the component. Not tested.

CHECKS:
- Combobox probes (13): typing "AP" → Apple+Grape; ArrowDown/Up wrap and skip disabled; all-disabled ArrowDown has no active option; regex chars "(", "[", ".", "*", "\" don't throw; Escape restores label with no onChange; Escape/Enter in a form when open doesn't submit; controlled ignoring onChange keeps label; external value change and unknown value; option ids valid and unique for "a b"/"x/y"; disabled click ignored; StrictMode select; empty options show No results → Enter does nothing → PASS; **Enter-clear → FAIL**; **blur-clear → FAIL**.
- Dialog probes (21): aria wiring and className; describedby only with description; closed renders nothing; focus to first focusable / dialog when none; disabled, tabindex=-1 and hidden skipped; Tab/Shift+Tab wrap; no-focusable Tab keeps focus; backdrop click closes; inside click and drag-from-inside don't close; Escape closes; focus restored to opener after Escape; StrictMode focus restore; controlled open=true stays open; Escape in open Combobox closes only the popup; nested Escape closes only inner; Escape with focus on body; onKeyDown still called → all PASS.
- Dialog extra (4): StrictMode Escape calls onOpenChange once; reopen restores focus again; empty-options ArrowDown/Enter does nothing; value=null click→ArrowDown→Enter selects → all PASS.
- Tabs probes (19): default first enabled; re-select doesn't fire onValueChange; controlled ignoring change; uncontrolled defaultValue; ids for "a b"/"x/y" and across two instances; disabled not clickable; tabIndex roving and Tab-to-panel; arrows wrap/skip/select-follows-focus, Home/End, other keys inert; arrows preventDefault; first/last disabled Home/End; all-but-one disabled; unmatched or disabled defaultValue falls back; tabs added after mount; removing selected tab; StrictMode arrows; value ""; user onKeyDown/onClick/className forwarded; controlled external change → all PASS.
- `pnpm test` / `pnpm typecheck` not re-run (orchestrator already ran them).

OPEN QUESTIONS: Spec C5/C8 says Enter/blur do nothing or restore the label, but the README and code deliberately clear to `null`. Which wins? The README also needs to change if the spec wins. Also, FEATURE_FLOW.md is listed in FILES but does not exist in the repo; should it be created or removed from the list?
